basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of PROJECT FELLOW under a project-based engagement with a tenure of 5 Years 3 Months. The required qualification for the post is M.Tech in VLSI or equivalent with 7 years experience, and the offered pay is Rs. 1,00,000 + HRA. Eligible candidates must apply by email by submitting their application with a CV, degree certificates, and experience certificates. The final date for application submission is 17 October 2026, and the interview is scheduled for 17 October 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare your application including your CV, degree certificates, and experience certificates.
Submit your application via email to [email protected].
Bring original degree certificates, experience certificates, and your CV at the time of the walk-in interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Project Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee)
COURSE FOR M.TECH VLSI FOR INDUSTRY PROFESSIONALS
Roorkee (may involve official travel and extended stays outside Roorkee)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Project Fellow position must meet the essential qualification requirement. Essential Qualification: M.Tech in VLSI or equivalent with 7 years experience. Category Preference: Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The approved emoluments for the Project Fellow position are Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 plus HRA, attached to a project duration of 5 Years 3 Months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Project Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare your application including your CV, degree certificates, and experience certificates. Submit your application via email to [email protected] . Bring original degree certificates, experience certificates, and your CV at the time of the walk-in interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview will be held at the HoD Conference Room, ECE Department on 17/10/2026 at 01:30 PM. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What are the emoluments for the IIT Roorkee Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 1,00,000 - Rs. 1,00,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q2. Who receives preference during the selection process?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents must be submitted or brought for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit or produce a CV, degree certificates, and experience certificates, and bring original degree and experience certificates for verification during the interview.

faq.question: Q4. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 17 October 2026 at 01:30 PM at the HoD Conference Room, ECE Department, IIT Roorkee.
